findings.location: REST-TR1.md §3 (stability rule), §7 row 'A noise model', §12 item 6; DESIGN.md TR1 'Verdict rules'
findings.problem: The verdict applies the cycle rule to presentations, each taken as one occasion with its 8-of-9 modal pick. If each fresh call, the stated unit, is read as its own ChoiceOccasions occasion, one dissenting call among nine is already a two-cycle in Shown. The design tolerates that, yet says the verdict 'tolerates no cycle' and that 'a verdict tolerating some cycles would test another claim'. So the correspondence tested is that the chooser's stable choice function accords with one strict order, not that every pick does.

findings.fix: State the bridge as 'the occasions are presentations and the pick is the stable (8-of-9) answer; that family accords with one strict order'. Say the call-level family, in which every call is an occasion, is not ruled on.
